title: Fused attention kernel selection timing race leads to subtle decoder numerical drift
creator: Marco Rivera
description: Summary: After enabling the new fused attention kernel selector path and aggressive prefill/decode scheduling heuristics, we observed small but reproducible numerical drift in model outputs during long decode sessions for a subset of models. The drift sometimes manifests as token-level deviations that cascade into semantic divergence for long conversations. This ticket captures investigation, short-term mitigation, and a long-term fix plan.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Checkout runtime at release candidate branch runtime-1.20-rc (sha: a1b2c3d).
2) Start a local dedicated worker with fused-attn-selector feature flag set to 'auto' and scheduler_mode='mixed-prefetch'.
3) Use the attached minimal reproducer (decode script) with model rwd-open-6b and prompt length of ~256 tokens, then run decode to 1024 tokens.
4) Repeat the run 10x concurrently.
5) Compare outputs across runs or against baseline runtime-1.19 fused flag disabled.
Expected: Deterministic outputs up to floating tolerance.
Observed: Small token substitutions starting ~token 300 that are not explained by stochastic sampling; differences grow over subsequent tokens.
reproducer: scripts/repro/eng-23042-decode-repro.py (internal gist link: drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED) - includes config to toggle fused kernel selector and scheduler policy.
logs:
Key snippets:
- scheduler: INFO kernel_selector picked fused_attn_v2 for layer 7, seq_len=128, batch=1
- kvcache: WARN evict candidate index=42 still referenced by active decode id=0x7f2a
- decoder: DEBUG softmax_sum mismatch delta=3.4e-5 layer=7
- attention_kernel: ERROR concurrent-kernel-swap detected timing window (t0=2026-03-07T14:22:07.123Z, t1=2026-03-07T14:22:07.125Z)
Stack traces and full logs uploaded to: s3://redwood-internal/eng/ENG-23042/logs.zip
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: numerical drift due to different floating-point rounding in fused_attn_v2 vs legacy kernels. Verified that a deterministic single-threaded run with fused_attn_v2 always matches itself (no internal nondeterminism).
- Second hypothesis: race between scheduler deciding which kernel to use and KV cache compaction/eviction step that moves KV blocks in memory. We found a narrow timing window where the kernel pointer is selected, then an async KV compaction moves the base pointer causing the kernel to read stale offsets.
- Instrumentation added: kernel_selector now emits kernel_version + pointer_epoch. KV cache compaction increments pointer_epoch. We saw cases where kernel_version=2 pointer_epoch=17 but by the time the kernel reads the KV the pointer_epoch had advanced to 18 and internal offsets were inconsistent.
- Reproducer only triggers under mixed-prefetch scheduling with >2 concurrent decode streams on the same worker and with aggressive kv_compaction_threshold set to 0.6.
- Numerical deltas were small (1e-5 to 1e-3) initially but propagate through softmax and cause token ranking differences at later steps.
- Related to but distinct from previous prefilling/KV index mismatch issues because this is a timing race at kernel selection time, not a persistent index corruption.
- Cross-checked on GPU types: reproducer seen on both A100 and H100, slightly more frequent on H100 (likely due to different CUDA kernel queue timings).
proposed_fix:
Short-term (hotfix): 1) Disable 'auto' fused-attn-selector by default; expose 'fused_attn_selector_strict_sync' config to force scheduler->kernel pointer handoff to be synchronized (atomic handoff). 2) Add a fast path that increments pointer_epoch under lock before scheduler returns kernel pointer. This reduces throughput slightly but eliminates race.
Long-term: 1) Introduce versioned KV handles: each kernel accepts a (kv_handle_version, base_ptr) tuple and validates at start-of-invoke that the handle matches expected version; if mismatch, kernel returns EBUSY and scheduler will reschedule or fallback to legacy kernel. 2) Move compaction to safe-points where no decode is using affected KV blocks (cooperative compaction). 3) Add a microbenchmark fuzz harness that stresses scheduler vs compaction interleavings across GPU types.
mitigation_applied:
Feature flag rolled: fused-attn-selector='off' for rows in prod autopool starting 2026-03-09. Config pushed to dedicated workers via infra patch infra/patches/2026-03-09-disable-fused-attn.json. Immediate impact: incident rate of decoder drift dropped to baseline.
Trade-off: 1-3% p99 latency regression under heavy mixed workloads while sync is on.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests: add deterministic kernel-selector unit that validates pointer_epoch invariants. 2) Integration: extended decode regression tests to run 50 concurrent decodes for 1024 tokens and compare token-level diffs against golden outputs; fail on >0.01% tokens diverging. 3) Fuzz: CI job that runs scheduler+kv_compaction fuzz matrix across GPU targets for 24 hours. 4) Performance: run load tests to quantify throughput/latency impacts of strict_sync and versioned-handle fallback. 5) Post-merge: canary rollout to 5% of traffic with detailed per-request KV pointer telemetry enabled.
rollout_plan:
- Prepare runtime-1.20.1-hotfix branch with short-term sync patch.
- Merge to canary cluster (canary=runtime-canary-3) for 48 hours running stress harness.
- If stable, promote to 20% traffic with monitoring for decoder-drift-alerts and p99 latency.
- Plan to merge long-term versioned-handle design in runtime-1.21 with staged rollout and no default compaction during transition.
followups: PM-412 (customer impact postmortem and comms for affected accounts)
comments: 2026-03-06 Marco Rivera: Initial triage. Reproducer attached and minimal logs show pointer_epoch mismatch. Assigning to Priya for deep dive.

2026-03-07 Priya Nair: Confirmed race window and added pointer_epoch instrumentation. Observed EBUSY-like symptoms when compaction overlaps kernel invocation. Working on short-term lock-based mitigation.
2026-03-09 Evan Green: Rolled feature flag off in prod autopool; customer incidents decreased. Captured perf regression numbers: p99 latency +2.1% under skews.
2026-03-12 Aisha Patel: Reviewed proposed long-term design. Suggest adding kernel-level fast sanity check (checksum of KV block header) to detect stale reads early and avoid silent numerical drift.
2026-03-14 Priya Nair: Implemented short-term sync patch branch and smoke tests. Pushing branch for infra canary deployment. Next: integrate kernel EBUSY handshake and add CI fuzz job.
